admissions_and_courses.source: Rajasthan Higher Education / Department of College Education
guidance: Admission schedules are session- and institution-specific.
Use the latest official HTE or concerned college notice.
Do not rely on an old admission deadline when answering a current question.
Course availability varies by college and should be checked on the concerned college's official page.

general_application_steps: Open the official Rajasthan Scholarship Portal.
Use the student/SSO login or registration flow shown by the portal.
Select the relevant academic year and scheme.
Enter the requested student, course and examination information.
Upload documents according to the selected scheme's current instructions.
Save application/reference details and monitor status on the official portal.

faq.question: Where should I check Rajasthan scholarship information?
faq.answer: Check the official Rajasthan Scholarship Portal and SJE Rajasthan. For higher-education scholarships and scooty schemes, also check the official HTE Rajasthan website.

faq.question: Can Rajasthan Smart Shiksha AI guarantee scholarship eligibility?
faq.answer: No. It can explain published rules, but final eligibility is determined under the applicable official scheme rules and verification process.

faq.question: Can the AI give an exact scholarship amount or deadline?
faq.answer: Only when that amount or deadline is explicitly present in a current verified official notification for the relevant scheme and academic year.

faq.question: What if my Jan Aadhaar details are incorrect?
faq.answer: Follow the current official Scholarship Portal/SJE instructions for correction or updating. Do not rely on an old correction deadline.

must_not_invent: Required documents not specified by the relevant official scheme
chatbot_rules.fallback: मुझे इस जानकारी की वर्तमान आधिकारिक पुष्टि नहीं मिली है। कृपया संबंधित राजस्थान सरकार/विभाग के नवीनतम आधिकारिक नोटिस या पोर्टल पर सत्यापन करें।
